fda_disclaimer: This statement has not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
testimonial_disclaimer: Individual results may vary. This statement has not been evaluated by the FDA.

risk_tiers.1_highest: Disease/outcome claims, branded Rx references, testimonials linking product to medical outcome
risk_tiers.2_very_high: Comparison to prescription drugs, dosing mirroring branded pharmaceuticals
risk_tiers.3_medium: Implied outcomes (melt fat away, reverse aging)
risk_tiers.4_low: Structure/function claims with compliant verbiage + FDA disclaimer
risk_tiers.5_lowest: Purely educational, research-oriented, fact-based with disclaimers

Sermorelin_5mg: Supports normal sleep and muscle recovery
TB500: Supports healthy cell migration and tissue repair

unacceptable_vs_compliant.good: Helps maintain healthy [body metric or process].
This peptide supports healthy thyroid function.
Supports occasional emotional balance and well-being.
Supports healthy metabolism within a normal range.

permitted: Using the word 'peptide' or describing 'peptide therapies'
Phrases like 'learn about the science of peptides'
not_permitted: Claiming any peptide treats, cures, or prevents a named disease
Naming and comparing unapproved products to brand drugs
Testimonials mentioning specific product and outcome
always_avoid: Specific peptide names followed by dosing mirroring branded drugs
